paper_metadata.title: HuatuoGPT, towards Taming Language Model to Be a Doctor
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper, we present HuatuoGPT, a large language model (LLM) for medical consultation. The core recipe of HuatuoGPT is to leverage both \textit{distilled data from ChatGPT} and \textit{real-world data from doctors} in the supervised fine-tuned stage. The responses of ChatGPT are usually detailed, well-presented and informative while it cannot perform like a doctor in many aspects, e.g. for integrative diagnosis. We argue that real-world data from doctors would be complementary to distilled data in the sense the former could tame a distilled language model to perform like doctors. To better leverage the strengths of both data, we train a reward model to align the language model with the merits that both data bring, following an RLAIF (reinforced learning from AI feedback) fashion. To evaluate and benchmark the models, we propose a comprehensive evaluation scheme (including automatic and manual metrics). Experimental results demonstrate that HuatuoGPT achieves state-of-the-art results in performing medical consultation among open-source LLMs in GPT-4 evaluation, human evaluation, and medical benchmark datasets. It is worth noting that by using additional real-world data and RLAIF, the distilled language model (i.e., HuatuoGPT) outperforms its teacher model ChatGPT in most cases. Our code, data, and models are publicly available at \url{https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT}. The online demo is available at \url{https://www.HuatuoGPT.cn/}.

extraction_data.innovation: Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback (RLAIF): replaces costly human feedback with an LLM-based reward model that scores responses on informativeness, coherence, and factual accuracy, then applies PPO with a KL penalty to align the model; Hybrid SFT Data: combines real doctor-patient conversations with LLM-refined synthetic data to enhance response quality and reduce overly colloquial outputs.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: 100K UAKE-QIC questions, real-world medical consultation data, distilled medical data
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF), Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning with AI Feedback (RLAIF), Instruction tuning, reinforcement learning with AI model feedback
extraction_data.extension: Two-stage training strategy: SFT with hybrid data (ChatGPT distilled + real-world doctor-patient) followed by RLAIF to mitigate weaknesses of both data sources.
extraction_data.research_problem: Medical language understanding and doctor-patient dialogue simulation
extraction_data.application: Medical question answering, doctor consultation simulation, health advice
extraction_data.paper_title: HuatuoGPT, towards Taming Language Model to Be a Doctor
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Distilled instructions (61,400), Real-world instructions (69,768), Distilled conversations (68,888), Real-world conversations (25,986), Huatuo-26M, cMedQA2, webMedQA, Chinese Alpaca dataset, ShareGPT, 54, 000 biomedical examples, ROCO dataset
extraction_data.training_pipeline: SFT with hybrid distilled and real-world data -> RLAIF
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Self-instruct for distilled instructions; two ChatGPTs role-playing doctor and patient for distilled conversations, LLM-based refinement of real doctor-patient conversations to enhance and refine data, Model-generated dataset comprising manually filtered 54, 000 biomedical examples
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: AI feedback, LLM-scored reward model trained on paired responses (informativeness, coherence, preference, factual accuracy), AI model feedback
extraction_data.vision_encoder: Microsoft GIT model fine-tuned on ROCO
extraction_data.benchmark_result: HuatuoGPT vs BenTsao: 100% win; vs DoctorGLM: 98% win (single-turn), 86% win (multi-turn); vs ChatGPT: 52% win (single-turn), 58% win (multi-turn); vs GPT-4: 10.5% win (single-turn); cMedQA2 BLEU-1: 25.37, ROUGE-1: 27.75; webMedQA BLEU-1: 24.61, ROUGE-1: 27.38; Huatuo-26M BLEU-1: 25.16, ROUGE-1: 27.76
